title: sideritis hirsuta var. hirta
intro: Sideritis hirsuta var. hirta, commonly known as the Iranian mountain tea or hairy sideritis, is a plant species belonging to the genus Sideritis, known for its medicinal properties. It is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, making it a potential remedy for various health issues. The therapeutic actions of Sideritis hirsuta var. hirta are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit neuroprotective properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal activities.
